name: imap-smtp-email

en.tagline: Read, search and send email over IMAP and SMTP
en.summary: This skill lets an agent read, search and manage email through IMAP, and send mail through SMTP. It works with Gmail, Outlook, several NetEase and QQ domains, and any standard IMAP/SMTP server. It supports multiple accounts and attachments, and it requires Node and npm.
problem: Checking mail, reading messages and sending replies usually means switching to a mail client or a web inbox. An agent working in a terminal cannot do this without a tool that speaks IMAP and SMTP.

With this skill, the agent can list new or unread messages, fetch a message by UID, search mailboxes by sender, subject or date, and mark messages as read or unread. It can also send email with attachments and download attachments to a folder. File access is limited to directories listed in the config.
fit: Checking for new or unread mail from a terminal or an agent workflow
Searching a mailbox by sender, subject or date range
Sending email with attachments, including to several recipients
Working with more than one mail account, such as work and personal
unfit: Mail providers that do not offer IMAP or SMTP access
Tasks that need a calendar; that is covered by the separate caldav-sync skill
steps: Run `bash setup.sh` to set up dependencies and add your account settings to `~/.config/mail-skills/.env`.
Set `PROVIDER` for a known server, or set `PROVIDER=custom` with `IMAP_HOST` and `SMTP_HOST` for other servers.
Add `--account <name>` to any command to use a named account, or leave it out to use the default account.
Read mail with `node scripts/imap.js check`, `fetch`, `search` or `download`, and change flags with `mark-read` or `mark-unread`.
Send mail with `node scripts/smtp.js send --to <email> --subject <text>`, adding `--body`, `--cc`, `--bcc` or `--attach` as needed.
Run `node scripts/smtp.js test` to confirm the SMTP connection works before relying on it.

zh.tagline: 用 IMAP/SMTP 读取、搜索和发送邮件
zh.summary: 这个技能让智能体通过 IMAP 读取、搜索和管理邮件，通过 SMTP 发送邮件。它支持 Gmail、Outlook、网易系多个域名、QQ 邮箱以及任何标准的 IMAP/SMTP 服务器。它支持多账号和附件，运行需要 Node 和 npm。
problem: 查看邮件、阅读内容、回复邮件，通常要切换到邮件客户端或网页邮箱。如果智能体在终端里工作，没有能使用 IMAP 和 SMTP 的工具，就无法完成这些操作。
使用这个技能后，智能体可以列出新邮件或未读邮件，按 UID 获取单封邮件，按发件人、主题或日期搜索邮箱，并标记已读或未读。它还能发送带附件的邮件，并把附件下载到指定目录。文件访问范围仅限配置中列出的目录。
fit: 在终端或智能体工作流中检查新邮件或未读邮件
按发件人、主题或日期范围搜索邮箱
发送带附件的邮件，包括发给多个收件人
同时使用多个邮箱账号，例如工作邮箱和个人邮箱
unfit: 邮箱服务不提供 IMAP 或 SMTP 访问
需要日历功能的任务，这类需求由单独的 caldav-sync 技能负责
steps: 运行 `bash setup.sh`，完成依赖配置，并把账号设置写入 `~/.config/mail-skills/.env`。
如果使用已知服务商，设置 `PROVIDER`；如果使用其他服务器，设置 `PROVIDER=custom`，并填写 `IMAP_HOST` 和 `SMTP_HOST`。
在任意命令前加上 `--account <name>` 可使用指定账号；不加则使用默认账号。
用 `node scripts/imap.js` 的 `check`、`fetch`、`search` 或 `download` 读取邮件，用 `mark-read` 或 `mark-unread` 修改已读状态。
用 `node scripts/smtp.js send --to <email> --subject <text>` 发送邮件，按需加上 `--body`、`--cc`、`--bcc` 或 `--attach`。
在正式使用前运行 `node scripts/smtp.js test`，确认 SMTP 连接正常。
